ModMetaData.name: RimUtinni: The Unfinished Line
ModMetaData.author: Mandrake
ModMetaData.description:
Nobody on this planet mass-produces droids. The Geonosian Foundry Hive knows how, and the factory patterns sit latent in their databases, but they are left-behind workers from a factory site, not a whole people, and they cannot run the line. The Free Droid Enclaves need it badly: they are escaped droids who can only repair each other, and every one they lose is lost for good. The Jawa are the only ones who can stand between them.
A five-beat quest chain (design/Jawa/proposals/droid_mass_production_quest_chain_2026-10-02.md). The chain is offered once the Free Droid Enclaves like you (goodwill 20), you can repair droids at a shop, and day 30 has passed. Each beat follows the last after a few days; a failed beat is offered again, and too many failures break the chain.
Built so far: the chain itself; beat 1, "The Count": three badly damaged Enclave droids brought to your shop (fit them your own good parts or scrounge worn ones; the Enclaves judge the job by the worst droid that walks out); and beat 2, "The Envoy": two Hive overseers and their Enclave escort stay four days, and accepting them starts a truce the Enclaves broker, holding the Hive's raids off while the chain runs. Harm a guest and the truce and the chain are over. Later beats (where the line stands, the pattern cores, the tithe, first light) are filed and not built yet; the chain waits after beat 2 until they ship.
Mod Settings ("The Unfinished Line"): chain on/off, the goodwill and day gates, days between beats, failures allowed per beat, the brokered truce on/off. Dev mode: Debug actions, Quests, "Offer The Unfinished Line (skip gates)" and "offer next beat now".
